state.intent: Connect verified Taiwan Stock Exchange daily equity price and total-return indices to the visual morning market product.
catalog: Existing MorningBoard Policy, positioning & capital disclosure with PolicyRates, institutional positioning and central-bank news timeline
Existing panel, panelHead, panelSubtitle, finePrint, up/down, status and shared light/dark tokens
Reusable accessible SVG Sparkline and existing international source drawer
MorningBoard supports MARKET/SPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA/TLT and daily/weekly/monthly windows with immutable historical selection
Top-level morning two-column Rates/liquidity and Currencies panels precede Go a level deeper research disclosures.

tokens.colors: var(--panel), var(--text), var(--text-secondary), var(--text-muted), var(--line), var(--accent), var(--up), var(--down)
tokens.motion: No required animation; reduced motion preserved

totalReturnIndex.history: 3 actual November daily observations; reinvested distributions

facts.license: Open Government Data License 1.0; TWSE 2026 attribution with links
facts.scope: Taiwan listed-equity index context only; two related measures of the same market, not independent votes or US ETF outcome prices

constraints: Keep both indices distinct, date and index-point units visible. Do not compare absolute levels on a shared scale.
No directional scores or US projections arise from this context. Other global regions and all missing US prices remain gaps.
Only saved signals appear in historical editions; earlier archives stay byte-identical.
Each feed can fail independently. Show unavailable/stale/retained notices using original dates.
Do not add provider scripts, external widgets, paid APIs or decorative unsupported market graphics.

previousDecision.placement: No original placement fits; expand candidates.

placement.instructions: With paired rows selected, choose a coherent placement from the expanded options. Keep Taiwan-only coverage explicit and preserve the page hierarchy.

criteria.after_currencies: Place a full-width Taiwan equity panel immediately below the top-level currencies/rates row and before Go a level deeper.
criteria.global_disclosure: Rename existing disclosure 01 Global markets, positioning & capital and put Taiwan rows first, followed by four policy rates and existing institutions/news/capital.
criteria.separate_disclosure: Add International equities as a separate disclosure after the four existing research disclosures, only when Taiwan signals exist.
